evidence.why: Complete current aerial loop IASA body.

facts.rationale: Replaces the obsolete held_inputs field spelling while preserving exact arguments and the independent IASA exit.
facts.value: Obtains Fighter from gobj, decrements mv.zd.specials.xC, and clamps a nonpositive result to zero. When that gate expires, it tests input.held_buttons[0] mask 512. If the mask is absent, it calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState with state 348, flags 0, frame 0, rate 1, blend 0, and NULL. This callback does not test projectile tracking or x0/x4.

evidence.why: Creation, effect, counter and mutually exclusive ownership branches.

facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported unconditional no-underflow claim and makes ownership-loss ordering and the separate IASA exit explicit.
facts.value: When cmd_vars[0] equals 1 and no item is tracked, consumes the command and attempts projectile creation. A non-null result installs damage/death callbacks; effect 1275 is emitted for every guarded attempt. Independently decrements x0 and x4 whenever each is nonzero, without a general clamp for negative values. If the tracked pointer is null at the subsequent branch, requests state 345 only when both counters are nonpositive. Otherwise checks the item's owner and clears tracking on mismatch; that clearing does not evaluate the no-item exit in the same invocation. The paired IASA callback can request state 345 independently.
